scope: headless Chromium, local production Next server and PostgreSQL TCP fixture
checks: Signed Join updates progress, shared wallet and server leaderboard without reload
Join, tracking and quiz complete once; all 70 points persisted
Browser and actual production server restart preserve completed actions
Rejected wallet signature does not award points
Modified origin-bound proof is rejected before wallet signing
Account change while signing prevents the old proof from being claimed
Local open, settle, close, withdrawal and browser persistence complete without wallet financial RPC
Terminal renders with deterministic market fixture; live release stays disabled
Corrupt browser sandbox data has an accessible reset without clearing Community data
Editing the profile address invalidates a slow prior-account response
Profile history navigates older/newer pages with no invented rows or cursor loops
Claim files stay in-browser; valid raw amounts and malformed claim entries are handled
Mobile menu and keyboard page search navigate and close correctly
Blocked browser storage retains a usable in-memory virtual account without unhandled errors
